defects.description: Advancement adopts the previously clamped day instead of the original monthly anchor.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { Schedule } from "./src/schedule.js"; const s=new Schedule(); s.add("a","2024-01-31T09:00:00Z"); s.next("a"); console.log(s.next("a"));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,d): add, advance, advance. A naive month-to-month oracle treats the February date as the next anchor; the original anchor must survive clamping.

defects.description: Reservation expiry compares a wall instant with an elapsed-clock deadline.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { Clock } from "./src/clock.js"; import { Catalog } from "./src/catalog.js"; import { Reservations } from "./src/reservations.js"; const c=new Clock(0); const cat=new Catalog(); cat.register("repair"); const r=new Reservations(cat,c); const id=r.hold("repair",100000,100); c.advance(10); c.adjustWall(1000000); console.log(r.status(id));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a,b): hold, advance, wall adjustment, status at a million milliseconds. Clock is correct in both independent domains; Reservations uses the wrong domain. Happy tests advance synchronized clocks.
